# Lab 01 – Node.js and Express Server

**Student Name:** Sai keerthan 
**Section:** CSE-2A

## Objective
To understand Node.js fundamentals and create a web server using the Express.js framework.

## Technologies Used
- Node.js
- Express.js
- JavaScript
- Visual Studio Code

## Installation
```bash
npm init -y
npm install express
```

## Run the Project
```bash
node server.js
```

## API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/` | Welcome message |
| GET | `/about` | Student details |
| GET | `/time` | Current date and time |
| GET | `/contact` | 404 error demonstration |

## Local Server
`http://localhost:3000/`

## Screenshots
All screenshots are available in the `screenshots/` folder.

## Conclusion
Successfully created a basic Node.js HTTP server and an Express server with multiple GET routes and 404 error handling.
